Public Works Department, Govt of Maharashtra
Letter of Recommendation
Letter of Recommendation
Our ref: 83
March 31, 2026
This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work “WTP Augmentation —
Maharashtra Pkg-93” (INR 21,42,00,000/-), completed on May 26, 2021. On the basis of that
engagement we record the following:
Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site;
Responsiveness of the contractor's site management.
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and cost, and
their conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for similar works.
Verification: Jaya Reddy, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000.
